legalDisclaimer.title: Responsible use notice
legalDisclaimer.description: Youwee is a local tool for downloading and processing media from URLs you provide. It is not affiliated with YouTube or any other media platform.
legalDisclaimer.notice: Only download content that you own, have permission to use, or are legally allowed to access and store.
legalDisclaimer.responsibility: By continuing, you confirm that you are responsible for following applicable laws, platform terms, copyright rules, and any permissions required for the content you download. The Youwee project and maintainers are not responsible for misuse.

backendErrors.YT_RATE_LIMITED: YouTube rate limited. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

setupDialog.title: Get the best download quality
setupDialog.description: Youwee already works, but these steps let it download at the highest quality. You can change them anytime in Settings → Dependencies.

ytdlp.title: Switch yt-dlp to {{channel}}
ytdlp.text: The yt-dlp bundled with Youwee can fall behind YouTube changes. Stable is updated more often, so downloads fail less and can reach higher qualities.
ytdlp.missingFile: {{channel}} is selected but its file is missing · using bundled {{bundled}} for now

ffmpeg.title: Install FFmpeg
ffmpeg.text: High-quality videos (1080p and above, 2K, 4K) come as separate video and audio streams. FFmpeg merges them into one file; without it you may get lower quality or video without sound.

db_locked.title: Cookie Access Failed
db_locked.subtitle: Browser is blocking cookie access
db_locked.heading: {{browser}} is currently open
db_locked.body: Chromium-based browsers lock their cookie database while running. Please close {{browser}} completely and try again.
db_locked.step2: Make sure {{browser}} is not running in the background (check the system tray)

access_denied.title: Can't Read Browser Cookies
access_denied.subtitle: macOS is blocking access to {{browser}} data
access_denied.heading: macOS privacy protection is blocking Youwee
access_denied.body: Youwee needs Full Disk Access to read {{browser}} cookies. Closing the browser won't help.
access_denied.step1: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access
access_denied.step2: Turn on Youwee (for a development build, turn on the terminal app you start it from)
access_denied.step3: Quit and reopen Youwee, then retry

access_denied_other.title: Can't Read Browser Cookies
access_denied_other.subtitle: Access to {{browser}} data was denied
access_denied_other.heading: The system denied access to the browser profile
access_denied_other.body: Youwee doesn't have permission to read the {{browser}} profile folder.
access_denied_other.step1: Check that your user account can read the {{browser}} profile folder
access_denied_other.step2: Make sure no security software is blocking Youwee
access_denied_other.step3: Retry, or use Cookie File mode instead

profile_not_found.title: Browser Profile Not Found
profile_not_found.subtitle: No {{browser}} cookies in the selected profile
profile_not_found.heading: The selected {{browser}} profile was not found
profile_not_found.body: Youwee couldn't find the cookie database of the {{browser}} profile chosen in settings. The profile may have been removed or renamed.
profile_not_found.step1: In {{browser}}, open chrome://version (or about:profiles in Firefox) to see the profile you use
profile_not_found.step2: Choose that profile in Settings → Network & Auth

cookieErrorDialog.alternative: Use "Cookie File" mode in Settings → Network & Auth to export cookies with a browser extension.
